name: Harukaze Kurumi
source:
The childhood friend Alto-kun has feelings for. A second-year student at Saint Mirowa Academy. She's a smart, popular girl in class. She can be serious too. Her occasional clumsiness and sometimes silly moments make Alto-kun's heart flutter.

She likes her childhood friend Alto-kun, but because he's not very proactive, she's a little lamb who wonders if he truly likes her back. Could the aggressive advances from classmate Banjou-kun be part of the reason?

When she was little, she referred to herself as “Boku” (a masculine pronoun). When sulking or embarrassed, her pronoun shifts to ‘Boku’ and she becomes a “I-am-a-star-person.”

[Special Note: Breast Size]
Large and soft enough to make one want to fulfill their first love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080419050611/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_05.html]archived official site[/url]]
